'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]; [[Taliban insurgency]]
***Two judges, both female, are shot dead in an ambush while en-route to their offices at the [[Supreme Court of Afghanistan|Supreme Court]] in [[Kabul]]; their driver is wounded. Afghan officials claim the [[Taliban]] is responsible, however no one has claimed responsibility for the attack and a spokesman for the Taliban, [[Zabihullah Mujahid]], says that the group was not responsible. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/17/two-afghan-women-judges-shot-dead-in-kabul-ambush (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Darfur]]
**[[2021 Darfur clashes]]
***Eighty-three people are killed during clashes between different [[ethnic group]]s in [[El Geneina]], [[West Darfur]], [[Sudan]]. They started after a row in which a man was stabbed to death. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55695118 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Sulawesi earthquake]]
**More bodies are found under debris in [[Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]], after a magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck the island two days ago, bringing the death toll to 78. [https://www.reuters.com/article/APAC/idUSKBN29M01Q?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A [[Bell UH-1 Iroquois]] helicopter of the [[Philippine Air Force]] [[aviation accidents and incidents|crashes]] in the [[Pantaron Mountain Range]] in [[Bukidnon]], [[Philippines]], killing all seven personnel onboard. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/01/16/world/asia/philippines-helicopter-crash-npa-military.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Six people have been killed by [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s that affected nine subdistricts and 33 neighborhoods in [[Manado]], [[North Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://en.antaranews.com/news/166092/six-killed-in-manado-citys-massive-floods-landslides (Antara News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 9,102 recoveries, bringing the total number of recoveries to 736,460. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5337581/rekor-9102-pasien-covid-19-sembuh-terbanyak-di-dki-jabar (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]]
****[[Lebanon]] signs a deal to receive two million doses of the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1794071 (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oman]]
****[[Oman]] announces the closure of all land borders for at least one week, beginning tomorrow at 6:00 p.m., as part of measures to reduce the spread of [[COVID-19]]. [https://timesofoman.com/article/oman-to-close-land-ports-supreme-committee (''Times of Oman'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****The [[United Arab Emirates]] reports a record 3,453 new confirmed cases in a single-day, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 253,261. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/uae/health/coronavirus-uae-announces-record-3-453-covid-19-cases-1.1147653 (''The National'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Guinea]]
****[[President of Guinea|Guinean President]] [[Alpha Condé]] receives the first dose of [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://www.africanews.com/2021/01/16/guinea-s-president-conde-receives-russian-covid-vaccine/ (Africanews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[South Africa]] delays the reopening of schools due to the rapid increase in cases of the 501.V2 variant. [https://apnews.com/article/health-africa-south-africa-coronavirus-pandemic-fc5353c498d184618af6a79484b1a4b2 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
****American music producer [[Phil Spector]], who was convicted for the [[Murder of Lana Clarkson|2003 murder]] of American actress [[Lana Clarkson]], dies from COVID-19 at a hospital in [[Northern California]]. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2021-01-17/phil-spector-dead (''Los Angeles Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Massachusetts]] reports their first case of a more contagious variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a woman in her 20s from [[Boston]] who traveled to the [[United Kingdom]] and began experiencing symptoms the day after she returned. [https://boston.cbslocal.com/2021/01/17/first-case-covid-19-variant-confirmed-massachusetts-united-kingdom/amp/ (WBZ-TV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***The [[Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency]] (Anvisa) grants [[emergency use authorization]] requests for the vaccines developed by [[Sinovac]] and [[Oxford University|Oxford]]-[[AstraZeneca]]. [https://g1.globo.com/bemestar/vacina/noticia/2021/01/17/relatora-na-anvisa-vota-a-favor-do-uso-emergencial-das-vacinas-coronovac-e-de-oxford.ghtml (G1)]
***Minutes after Anvisa's announcement, a nurse from [[São Paulo]] becomes the first person in Brazil to receive a COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil/brazil-authorizes-emergency-use-of-sinovac-astrazeneca-vaccines-idUSKBN29M0M3?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
***[[Austria]] extends their nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] until February 7 in order to reduce the spread of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] amid fears about new [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|SARS-CoV-2 variants]]. People will also be required to wear full protective masks beginning January 25. [https://www.dw.com/de/%C3%B6sterreich-bis-7-februar-im-corona-lockdown/a-56254093 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**[[Otero County, New Mexico|Otero County]] Commissioner [[Couy Griffin]], the founder of "Cowboys for [[Donald Trump|Trump]]", is arrested for his involvement during the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|storming]] of the [[United States Capitol]], in which he allegedly entered restricted area during the riot. He claimed to be planning to drive to [[Washington, D.C.]] with a rifle and revolver. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-protests-arrests/new-mexico-official-who-vowed-to-protest-biden-inauguration-arrested-in-washington-idUSKBN29M0RV (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/cowboys-trump-founder-arrested-after-allegedly-leading-capitol-rioters-prayer-n1254559 (NBC News)]
**Gracyn Courtright, a [[West Virginia]] student who is a senior at the [[University of Kentucky]], is charged for entering the [[United States Capitol]] during the riot. [https://nypost.com/2021/01/17/university-of-kentucky-senior-charged-over-alleged-capitol-riot-role/ (''New York Post'')] [http://www.kykernel.com/news/i-thought-it-was-cool-uk-student-charged-in-d-c-court-for-participation-in/article_6e26ed92-5922-11eb-8ec8-fbb53195ee20.html (''The Kentucky Kernel'')] [https://heavy.com/news/gracyn-courtright/ (Heavy.com)]
*Aftermath of the [[poisoning of Alexei Navalny]]
**[[opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|Opposition]] politician and anti-[[corruption in Russia|corruption]] activist [[Alexei Navalny]] is arrested upon landing in [[Moscow]], according to a statement from the prison service. The prominent Putin critic was arrested on charges of parole violations and terms of a suspended prison sentence and will be held in custody until a court makes a decision in his case. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/01/17/navalny-russia-putin-arrest-459973 (''Politico'')]
*[[Central American migrant caravans]]
**A caravan of at least 6,000 [[Honduran diaspora|Honduran migrants]] bound for the United States prompts the deployment of [[Law enforcement in Guatemala|Guatemalan police]] and [[Armed Forces of Guatemala|military]] troops to the [[Guatemala–Honduras border]], where security forces fire [[tear gas]] and assault migrants attempting to cross the border. Health officials report several casualties. [https://www.ibtimes.com/guatemala-police-fire-tear-gas-us-bound-migrant-caravan-afp-3124146 (AFP via ''IBTimes'')]
